std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n322\t\n323\t    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n324\t        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n325\t        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n326\t\n327\t        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n328\t            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n329\t            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n330\t            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n331\t            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n332\t            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n333\t            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n334\t            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n335\t            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n336\t            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n337\t            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n338\t            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n339\t            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n340\t        };\n341\t\n342\t        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n343\t        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n344\t            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n345\t            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n346\t            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n347\t            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n348\t        };\n349\t\n350\t        // Subdivide\n351\t        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n352\t            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n353\t            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n354\t\n355\t            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n356\t                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n357\t                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n358\t                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n359\t\n360\t                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n361\t                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n362\t                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n363\t                vertices.push_back(mid);\n364\t                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n365\t                return idx;\n366\t            };\n367\t\n368\t            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n369\t                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n370\t                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n371\t                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n372\t\n373\t                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n374\t                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n375\t                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n376\t                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n377\t            }\n378\t            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n379\t        }\n380\t\n381\t        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n382\t        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n383\t        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n384\t            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n385\t            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n386\t        }\n387\t    }\n388\t};\n389\t\n390\t// ============================================================================\n391\t// Random Number Generation\n392\t// ============================================================================\n393\t\n394\tclass RandomGenerator {\n395\t    std::mt19937 rng;\n396\t    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\n397\tpublic:\n398\t    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n399\t    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n400\t};\n401\t\n402\t// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\n403\tVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n404\t    val_t u = rng.rand();\n405\t    val_t v = rng.rand();\n406\t    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n407\t        u = 1.0f - u;\n408\t        v = 1.0f - v;\n409\t    }\n410\t    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n411\t    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n412\t    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n413\t}\n414\t\n415\t// ============================================================================\n416\t// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n417\t// ============================================================================\n418\t\n419\tval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n420\t                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n421\t    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n422\t    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n423\t    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n424\t    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n425\t\n426\t    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n427\t\n428\t    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n429\t    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n430\t    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n431\t    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n432\t\n433\t    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n434\t    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n435\t    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n436\t\n437\t    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n438\t}\n439\t\n440\t// ============================================================================\n441\t// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n442\t// ============================================================================\n443\t\n444\t// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n445\t// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\n446\tbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n447\t                  const Octree& octree,\n448\t                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n449\t    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n450\t    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n451\t    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n452\t    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n453\t\n454\t    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n455\t        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n456\t\n457\t        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n458\t        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n459\t            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n460\t        }\n461\t        return false;\n462\t    });\n463\t}\n464\t\n465\t// ============================================================================\n466\t// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n467\t// ============================================================================\n468\t\n469\t// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n470\tval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n471\t    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n472\t    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n473\t    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n474\t}\n475\t\n476\t// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n477\tval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n478\t                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n479\t                  const Octree& octree,\n480\t                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n481\t    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n482\t    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n483\t\n484\t    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n485\t    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n486\t\n487\t    val_t kij = ZERO;\n488\t\n489\t    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n490\t        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n491\t        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n492\t\n493\t        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n494\t\n495\t        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n496\t        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n497\t        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n498\t\n499\t        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n500\t        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n501\t\n502\t        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n503\t\n504\t        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n505\t    }\n506\t\n507\t    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n508\t}\n509\t\n510\t// ============================================================================\n511\t// Tau (time delay) Computation\n512\t// ============================================================================\n513\t\n514\tint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n515\t    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n516\t    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n517\t}\n518\t\n519\t// ============================================================================\n520\t// Room Response Simulation State\n521\t// ============================================================================\n522\t\n523\tstruct SimulationState {\n524\t    size_t numTriangles;\n525\t    size_t numTimesteps;\n526\t\n527\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n528\t    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n529\t    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n530\t    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n531\t    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n532\t    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n533\t    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n534\t    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n535\t\n536\t    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n537\t\n538\t    size_t sourceIndex;\n539\t\n540\t    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n541\t    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n542\t};\n543\t\n544\t// ============================================================================\n545\t// Initialization\n546\t// ============================================================================\n547\t\n548\tvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n549\t                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n550\t    // Generate mesh\n551\t    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n552\t    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n553\t    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n554\t    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n555\t    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n556\t\n557\t    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n558\t\n559\t    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n560\t    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n561\t    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n562\t\n563\t    // Initialize areas\n564\t    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n565\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n566\t        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n567\t    }\n568\t\n569\t    // Initialize reflectivity\n570\t    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n571\t\n572\t    // Initialize matrices\n573\t    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n574\t    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, 0);\n575\t    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n576\t    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n577\t    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n578\t\n579\t    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n580\t    size_t timeOn = 0;\n581\t    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n582\t    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n583\t        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n584\t    }\n585\t}\n586\t\n587\t// ============================================================================\n588\t// Precomputation Phase\n589\t// ============================================================================\n590\t\n591\tvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n592\t    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n593\t    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n594\t\n595\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n596\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n597\t            if (i == j) continue;\n598\t            state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeKij(\n599\t                i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n600\t        }\n601\t        if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n602\t            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n603\t        }\n604\t    }\n605\t}\n606\t\n607\tvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n608\t    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n609\t\n610\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n611\t        for (size_t j = 0; state.triangles[j]);\n615\t        }\n616\t    }\n617\t}\n618\t\n619\t// ============================================================================\n620\t// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n621\t// ============================================================================\n622\t\n623\tvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n624\t    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n625\t\n626\t    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n627\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n628\t            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n629\t\n630\t            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n631\t                if (i == j) continue;\n632\t\n633\t                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n634\t\n635\t                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n636\t                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n637\t\n638\t                val_t kij = state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n639\t                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n640\t\n641\t                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n642\t                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n643\t                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n644\t                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n645\t\n646\t                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n647\t                sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n648\t            }\n649\t\n650\t            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n651\t            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n652\t        }\n653\t\n654\t        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n655\t            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n656\t        }\n657\t    }\n658\t}\n659\t\n660\t// ============================================================================\n661\t// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n662\t// ============================================================================\n663\t\n664\tvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n665\t    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n666\t\n667\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n668\t        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n669\t        int bestT = 0;\n670\t\n671\t        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n672\t        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n673\t            val_t sum = ZERO;\n674\t\n675\t            for (size_t tt = t; tt < state.numTimesteps; ++tt) {\n676\t                val_t pB = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, i)];\n677\t                val_t pS = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt - t, state.sourceIndex)];\n678\t                sum += pS * pB;\n679\t            }\n680\t\n681\t            if (sum > maxCorr) {\n682\t                maxCorr = sum;\n683\t                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n684\t            }\n685\t        }\n686\t\n687\t        state.distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n688\t    }\n689\t}\n690\t\n691\t// ============================================================================\n692\t// Validation\n693\t// ============================================================================\n694\t\n695\tbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n696\t    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n697\t\n698\t    // Check that distances are non-negative\n699\t    bool allNonNegative = true;\n700\t    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n701\t    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n702\t    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n703\t    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n704\t\n705\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n706\t        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n707\t        if (d < 0) {\n708\t            allNonNegative = false;\n709\t            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n710\t        }\n711\t        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n712\t            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n713\t            return false;\n714\t        }\n715\t        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n716\t        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n717\t        sumDist += d;\n718\t        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n719\t    }\n720\t\n721\t    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n722\t    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n723\t    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n724\t\n725\t    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n726\t    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n727\t    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n728\t        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n729\t    }\n730\t\n731\t    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n732\t    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n733\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n734\t        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n735\t            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {\n736\t                receivedEnergy++;\n737\t                break;\n738\t            }\n739\t        }\n740\t    }\n741\t\n742\t    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n743\t\n744\t    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n745\t        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n746\t        return false;\n747\t    }\n748\t\n749\t    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n750\t    int factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n755\t           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,\n756\t           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));\n757\t\n758\t    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n759\t        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n760\t        return false;\n761\t    }\n762\t\n763\t    if (!allNonNegative) {\n764\t        return false;\n765\t    }\n766\t\n767\t    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n768\t    return true;\n769\t}\n770\t\n771\t// ============================================================================\n772\t// Hash for Verification\n773\t// ============================================================================\n774\t\n775\tuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n776\t    uint64_t hash = 0;\n777\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n778\t        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);\n779\t        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n780\t    }\n781\t    return hash;\n782\t}\n783\t\n784\t// ============================================================================\n785\t// Helper: Compute subdivision // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision\n790\t    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480\n791\t    int subdivisions = 0;\n792\t    int triangles = 20;\n793\t    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {\n794\t        subdivisions++;\n795\t        triangles *= 4;\n796\t    }\n797\t    return subdivisions;\n798\t}\n799\t\n800\t// ============================================================================\n801\t// Main\n802\t// ============================================================================\n803\t\n804\tvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n805\t    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n806\t    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n807\t    printf(\"  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: printf(\"  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\\n\");\n811\t    printf(\"  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\\n\");\n812\t    printf(\"  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 this help message\\n\");\n816\t}\n817\t\n818\tint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n819\t    int targetTriangles = 320;\n820\t    int timesteps = 50;\n821\t    int sourceIdx = 0;\n822\t    val_t ============================================================================\n//\n// The sequential original draws every sample from a single std::mt19937 stream\n// (seed 42), in row-major (i, j) The draws of\n// row i therefore start at a position that depends on the culling of all earlier\n// rows. To compute rows independently while reproducing that stream exactly, each\n// row's engine state is reconstructed by jump-ahead:\n//\n//  - The MT19937 output sequence obeys a linear recurrence over GF(2) with a\n//    primitive characteristic polynomial Q of degree L (found with\n//    Berlekamp-Massey on the output bits).\n//  - For a position p, x^p mod Q gives the coefficients that express the 624\n//    outputs starting at p as combinations of the first L outputs.\n//  - Untempering those 624 outputs yields the engine state at p.\n\nconstexpr int MT_N = 624;\nconstexpr int MT_M = 397;\nconstexpr uint32_t MT_SEED = 42;\nconstexpr size_t MT_DEGREE_BOUND = 19937; }\n\n// dst ^= src << shift\ninline void gf2XorShifted(uint64_t* dst, const uint64_t* src, size_t srcWords, size_t shift) {\n    const size_t ws = shift >> 6;\n    const size_t bs = shift & 63;\n    for (size_t w = 0; w > 0; --w) D[w] = (D[w] << 1) | (D[w - 1] >> 63);\n        D[0] <<= 1;\n        if (gf2Bit(D.data(), ja.deg)) {\n            for (size_t w = 0; w < W; ++w) D[w] ^= ja.q[w];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Berlekamp-Massey over GF(2). Returns connection polynomial C (C[0] = 1) with\n// s[n] = sum_{k=1..L} C[k] s[n-k] for all n >= L.\nstd::vector<uint8_t> berlekampMassey(const std::vector<uint8_t>& s, size_t& Lout) {\n    const size_t n = s.size();\n    std::vector<uint8_t> C(n + 1, 0), B(n + 1, 0), T;\n    C[0] = 1;\n    B[0] = 1;\n    size_t L = 0;\n    long m = -1;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        uint8_t d = s[i];\n        for (size_t k = 1; k <= L; ++k) d ^= C[k] & s[i - k];\n        if (d) {\n            T = C;\n            const size_t shift = static_cast<size_t>(static_cast<long>(i) - m);\n            for (size_t k = 0; k + shift <= n; ++k) C[k + shift] ^= B[k];\n            if (2 * L <= i) {\n                L = i + 1 - L;\n                m = static_cast<long>(i);\n                B = T;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    C.resize(L + 1);\n    Lout = L;\n    return C;\n}\n\n// Builds the jump-ahead tables. Rank 0 runs Berlekamp-Massey; the result is broadcast.\nJumpAhead buildJumpAhead(uint64_t maxPosition) {\n    JumpAhead ja;\n    constexpr size_t NB = 2 * MT_DEGREE_BOUND + 64;  // Output bits used by Berlekamp-Massey\n\n    uint64_t L = 0;\n    std::vector<uint64_t> qTmp;\n    if (gRank == 0) {\n        std::mt19937 gen(MT_SEED);\n        std::vector<uint8_t> bits(NB);\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < NB; ++k) bits[k] = static_cast<uint8_t>(gen() & 1u);\n\n        size_t degree = 0;\n        const std::vector<uint8_t> C = berlekampMassey(bits, degree);\n        if (2 * degree > NB) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"Jump-ahead: recurrence degree %zu exceeds the bit budget\\n\", degree);\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n        }\n        L = degree;\n        qTmp.assign(L / 64 + 1, 0);\n        // Q(x) = sum_k C[k] x^(L-k)\n        for (size_t k = 0; k <= L; ++k) {\n            if (C[k]) {\n                const size_t bit = L - k;\n                qTmp[bit >> 6] |= 1ull << (bit & 63);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    MPI_Bcast(&L, 1, MPI_UINT64_T, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    ja.deg = static_cast<size_t>(L);\n    ja.words = ja.deg / 64 + 1;\n    if (gRank != 0) qTmp.assign(ja.words, 0);\n    MPI_Bcast(qTmp.data(), static_cast<int>(ja.words), MPI_UINT64_T, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    ja.q = qTmp;\n\n    // Base outputs w_0 .. w_{L-1}\n    std::mt19937 gen(MT_SEED);\n    ja.base.resize(ja.deg);\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < ja.deg; ++k) ja.base[k] = static_cast<uint32_t>(gen());\n\n    // Squarings x^(2^k) mod Q for every exponent bit that can occur\n    size_t bitsNeeded = 1;\n    while ((uint64_t{1} << bitsNeeded) <= maxPosition) ++bitsNeeded;\n    ja.xpow.assign(bitsNeeded, std::vector<uint64_t>(ja.words, 0));\n    ja.xpow[0][0] = 2;  // x\n    for (size_t k = 1; k < bitsNeeded; ++k) gf2MulMod(ja, ja.xpow[k - 1].data(), ja.xpow[k - 1].data(), ja.xpow[k].data());\n    return ja;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Random Number Generation (device side)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Per-thread MT19937 state, as used by one receiver row on the device\nstruct MTState {\n    uint32_t mt[MT_N];\n    uint32_t idx;\n};\n\n__device__ inline uint32_t mtNextRaw(MTState& s) {\n    if (s.idx >= static_cast<uint32_t>(MT_N)) {\n        for (int k = 0; k < MT_N; ++k) {\n            const uint32_t y = (s.mt[k] & 0x80000000u) | (s.mt[(k + 1) % MT_N] & 0x7fffffffu);\n            s.mt[k] = s.mt[(k + MT_M) % MT_N] ^ (y >> 1) ^ ((y & 1u) ? 0x9908b0dfu : 0u);\n        }\n        s.idx = 0;\n    }\n    return mtTemper(s.mt[s.idx++]);\n}\n\n// Same value as std::uniform_real_distribution<float>(0,1) over std::mt19937\n__device__ inline val_t mtUniform(MTState& s) {\n    const val_t u = static_cast<val_t>(mtNextRaw(s)) / 4294967296.0f;\n    return u < ONE ? u : 0.99999994f;  // largest float below 1\n}\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\n__device__ Vec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, MTState& rng) {\n    val_t u = mtUniform(rng);\n    val_t v = mtUniform(rng);\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\n__device__ val_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                                      const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Ray-box slab test of a flattened octree node (separating axis form)\n__device__ bool nodeIntersectsRay(const FlatOctreeNode& node, const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) {\n    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n    Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;\n    Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};\n\n    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nconstexpr int TRAVERSAL_STACK_SIZE = 128;\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle.\n// Traverses the flattened octree, returning true as soon as a blocking triangle is found.\n__device__ bool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                             const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const uint32_t* triIdx, const Triangle* tris,\n                             uint32_t srcTriIdx, uint32_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    uint32_t stack[TRAVERSAL_STACK_SIZE];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;  // root\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--sp]];\n        if (node.triCount > 0) {\n            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triCount; ++k) {\n                const uint32_t idx = triIdx[node.triBegin + k];\n                if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) continue;\n                const Triangle& tri = tris[idx];\n                const val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) return true;\n            }\n        } else {\n            for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) {\n                const int32_t ch = node.child[c];\n                if (ch >= 0 && nodeIntersectsRay(nodes[ch], from, to)) stack[sp++] = ch;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n__device__ val_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    val_t c = v.dot(normal) / vNorm;\n    return c > ZERO ? c : ZERO;\n}\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter).\n// The caller guarantees that the pair is neither the diagonal nor culled.\n__device__ val_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n                            const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const uint32_t* triIdx, const Triangle* tris,\n                            MTState& rng) {\n    const Triangle& triI = tris[idxI];\n    const Triangle& triJ = tris[idxJ];\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, nodes, triIdx, tris, static_cast<uint32_t>(idxI), static_cast<uint32_t>(idxJ))) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI._normal);\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ._normal);\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// One thread per receiver row. The row's draws are the consecutive part of the\n// sequential stream that starts at the row's engine state.\n__global__ void formFactorKernel(size_t i0, size_t rows, size_t N, size_t maskWords,\n                                 const Triangle* tris, const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const uint32_t* triIdx,\n                                 const uint64_t* skipBits, const uint32_t* rowStates, val_t* kij) {\n    const size_t r = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x;\n    if (r >= rows) return;\n\n    const size_t i = i0 + r;\n    MTState rng;\n    for (int k = 0; k < MT_N; ++k) rng.mt[k] = rowStates[r * MT_N + k];\n    rng.idx = 0;\n\n    const uint64_t* skip = skipBits + r * maskWords;\n    val_t* out = kij + r * N;\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n        const bool skipPair = (skip[j >> 6] >> (j & 63)) & 1u;\n        out[j] = skipPair ? ZERO : computeKij(i, j, nodes, triIdx, tris, rng);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Splits N rows into contiguous blocks; rank r owns [begin, begin + count)\nvoid partitionRows(size_t N, int rank, int size, size_t& begin, size_t& count) {\n    const size_t base = N / static_cast<size_t>(size);\n    const size_t rem = N % static_cast<size_t>(size);\n    const size_t r = static_cast<size_t>(rank);\n    count = base + (r < rem ? 1 : 0);\n    begin = r * base + std::min(r, rem);\n}\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    size_t rowBegin;   // First receiver row owned by this rank\n    size_t rowCount;   // Number of receiver rows owned by this rank\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle (replicated)\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0) (replicated)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors of owned rows (rowCount x N, row-major)\n    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays of owned rows (rowCount x N, row-major)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N, replicated)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N, replicated)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances (N, replicated after gather)\n\n    std::vector<FlatOctreeNode> octNodes;  // Flattened octree for the device\n    std::vector<uint32_t> octTris;\n\n    size_t idxLocal(size_t i, size_t j) const { return (i - rowBegin) * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n    partitionRows(state.numTriangles, gRank, gSize, state.rowBegin, state.rowCount);\n\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration and flatten it for the device\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    Octree octree;\n    octree.build(state.triangles);\n    state.octNodes.clear();\n    state.octTris.clear();\n    flattenOctree(octree, state.octNodes, state.octTris);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Initialize matrices\n    state.kij.assign(state.rowCount * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.tau.assign(state.rowCount * state.numTriangles, 0);\n    state.radE.assign(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.radB.assign(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.distances.assign(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < state.rowCount; ++r) {\n        const size_t i = state.rowBegin + r;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.tau[r * N + j] = computeTau(state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Pair (i, j) is skipped when i == j or when the facing normals are nearly parallel\n// (culled). skipBits holds one bit per pair (row-major, maskWords words per row),\n// and drawCount[i] is the number of pairs of row i that draw random numbers.\nvoid buildSkipBits(const std::vector<Triangle>& tris, size_t N, size_t maskWords,\n                   std::vector<uint64_t>& skipBits, std::vector<uint64_t>& drawCount) {\n    skipBits.assign(N * maskWords, 0);\n    drawCount.assign(N, 0);\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 16)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        uint64_t* row = skipBits.data() + i * maskWords;\n        const Vec3 ni = tris[i]._normal;\n        uint64_t skipped = 0;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            const bool skip = (i == j) || (ni.dot(tris[j]._normal) > 0.99f);\n            if (skip) {\n                row[j >> 6] |= 1ull << (j & 63);\n                ++skipped;\n            }\n        }\n        drawCount[i] = N - skipped;\n    }\n}\n\n// Computes form factors of the rank's rows on its GPU\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state, const JumpAhead& ja,\n                        const std::vector<uint64_t>& skipBits, size_t maskWords,\n                        const std::vector<uint64_t>& drawPos) {\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t R = state.rowCount;\n    const size_t i0 = state.rowBegin;\n\n    // Engine state at the start of every owned row (jump-ahead, parallel over threads)\n    std::vector<uint32_t> rowStates(R * MT_N, 0);\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        const size_t nthr = static_cast<size_t>(omp_get_num_threads());\n        const size_t tid = static_cast<size_t>(omp_get_thread_num());\n        const size_t b0 = R * tid / nthr;\n        const size_t b1 = R * (tid + 1) / nthr;\n        if (b0 < b1) {\n            std::vector<uint64_t> X(ja.words), next(ja.words), step(ja.words);\n            std::map<uint64_t, std::vector<uint64_t>> stepCache;\n            gf2PowX(ja, drawPos[i0 + b0], X.data());\n            for (size_t r = b0; r < b1; ++r) {\n                gf2EngineWindow(ja, X.data(), &rowStates[r * MT_N]);\n                if (r + 1 < b1) {\n                    const uint64_t draws = drawPos[i0 + r + 1] - drawPos[i0 + r];\n                    auto it = stepCache.find(draws);\n                    if (it == stepCache.end()) {\n                        gf2PowX(ja, draws, step.data());\n                        it = stepCache.emplace(draws, step).first;\n                    }\n                    gf2MulMod(ja, X.data(), it->second.data(), next.data());\n                    X.swap(next);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Device buffers (triangles and octree are replicated; rows are local)\n    Triangle* dTris = nullptr;\n    FlatOctreeNode* dNodes = nullptr;\n    uint32_t* dTriIdx = nullptr;\n    uint64_t* dSkip = nullptr;\n    uint32_t* dStates = nullptr;\n    val_t* dKij = nullptr;\n\n    const size_t kijCount = R * N;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dTris, state.triangles.size() * sizeof(Triangle)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dNodes, state.octNodes.size() * sizeof(FlatOctreeNode)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dTriIdx, state.octTris.size() * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dSkip, std::max<size_t>(R * maskWords, 1) * sizeof(uint64_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dStates, std::max<size_t>(R * MT_N, 1) * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dKij, std::max<size_t>(kijCount, 1) * sizeof(val_t)));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dTris, state.triangles.data(), state.triangles.size() * sizeof(Triangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dNodes, state.octNodes.data(), state.octNodes.size() * sizeof(FlatOctreeNode), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dTriIdx, state.octTris.data(), state.octTris.size() * sizeof(uint32_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    if (R > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dSkip, skipBits.data() + i0 * maskWords, R * maskWords * sizeof(uint64_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dStates, rowStates.data(), R * MT_N * sizeof(uint32_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        constexpr int THREADS = 32;\n        const int blocks = static_cast<int>((R + THREADS - 1) / THREADS);\n        formFactorKernel<<<blocks, THREADS>>>(i0, R, N, maskWords, dTris, dNodes, dTriIdx, dSkip, dStates, dKij);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.kij.data(), dKij, kijCount * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dTris));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dNodes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dTriIdx));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dSkip));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dStates));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dKij));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Per-rank element counts and displacements for a row-block distribution\nvoid rowBlockLayout(size_t N, std::vector<int>& counts, std::vector<int>& displs) {\n    counts.assign(gSize, 0);\n    displs.assign(gSize, 0);\n    for (int r = 0; r < gSize; ++r) {\n        size_t begin = 0, count = 0;\n        partitionRows(N, r, gSize, begin, count);\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(count);\n        displs[r] = static_cast<int>(begin);\n    }\n}\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state, const std::vector<int>& counts, const std::vector<int>& displs) {\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (size_t r = 0; r < state.rowCount; ++r) {\n            const size_t i = state.rowBegin + r;\n            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n                if (i == j) continue;\n\n                int tauij = state.tau[r * N + j];\n\n                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n\n                val_t kij = state.kij[r * N + j];\n                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n                sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n            }\n\n            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n        }\n\n        // Share this timestep's radiosity of every rank's rows\n        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, state.radB.data() + t * N,\n                       counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_FLOAT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n            ROOT_PRINTF(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state, const std::vector<int>& counts, const std::vector<int>& displs) {\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < state.rowCount; ++r) {\n        const size_t i = state.rowBegin + r;\n        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n        int bestT = 0;\n\n        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            val_t sum = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t tt = t; tt < state.numTimesteps; ++tt) {\n                val_t pB = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, i)];\n                val_t pS =            Vec3 childCenter = center;\n                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n\n                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n        bool canSplit = false;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n                canSplit = true;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!canSplit) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Build children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n                Vec3 childMin = center;\n                Vec3 childMax = center;\n                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n\n                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// Flattened octree node (POD) that can be traversed on the device.\n// A node is a leaf when triCount > 0; otherwise child[] holds node indices (-1 = none).\nstruct FlatOctreeNode {\n    Vec3 center, halfExtent;\n    int32_t child[8];\n    uint32_t triBegin, triCount;\n};\n\n// Copies the host octree into flat arrays; node 0 is the root.\nint32_t flattenOctree(const Octree& node, std::vector<FlatOctreeNode>& nodes,\n                      std::vector<uint32_t>& triIdx) {\n    const int32_t id = static_cast<int32_t>(nodes.size());\n    nodes.push_back({});\n\n    FlatOctreeNode flat{};\n    flat.center = node.center;\n    flat.halfExtent = node.halfExtent;\n    for (int32_t& c : flat.child) c = -1;\n\n    if (!node.triangleIndices.empty()) {\n        flat.triBegin = static_cast<uint32_t>(triIdx.size());\n        flat.triCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(node.triangleIndices.size());\n        for (size_t idx : node.triangleIndices) triIdx.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(idx));\n    } else {\n        for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) {\n            if (node.children[c]) flat.child[c] = flattenOctree(*node.children[c], nodes, triIdx);\n        }\n    }\n\n    nodes[id] = flat;\n    return id;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\nclass IcosphereMesh {\npublic:\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Exact random-stream support (MT19937 jump-ahead)\n// ============================================================================\n//\n// The sequential original draws every sample from a single std::mt19937 stream\n// (seed 42), in row-major (i, j) order; culled pairs draw nothing. The draws of\n// row i therefore start at a position that depends on the culling of all earlier\n// rows. To compute rows independently while reproducing that stream exactly, each\n// row's engine state is reconstructed by jump-ahead:\n//\n//  - The MT19937 output sequence obeys a linear recurrence over GF(2) with a\n//    primitive characteristic polynomial Q of degree L (found with\n//    Berlekamp-Massey on the output bits).\n//  - For a position p, x^p mod Q gives the coefficients that express the 624\n//    outputs starting at p as combinations of the first L outputs.\n//  - Untempering those 624 outputs yields the engine state at p.\n\nconstexpr int MT_N = 624;\nconstexpr int MT_M = 397;\nconstexpr uint32_t MT_SEED = 42;\nconstexpr size_t MT_DEGREE_BOUND = 19937;  // Degree of the MT19937 characteristic polynomial\n\nHD inline uint32_t mtTemper(uint32_t y) {\n    y ^= (y >> 11);\n    y ^= (y << 7) & 0x9d2c5680u;\n    y ^= (y << 15) & 0xefc60000u;\n    y ^= (y >> 18);\n    return y;\n}\n\ninline uint32_t mtUntemper(uint32_t y) {\n    y ^= (y >> 18);\n    y ^= (y << 15) & 0xefc60000u;\n    uint32_t x = y;\n    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) x = y ^ ((x << 7) & 0x9d2c5680u);\n    y = x;\n    return y ^ (y >> 11) ^ (y >> 22);\n}\n\n// Polynomial arithmetic over GF(2), bit-packed into 64-bit words\nstruct JumpAhead {\n    size_t deg = 0;                            // L: degree of the characteristic polynomial\n    size_t words = 0;                          // words holding a residue modulo Q\n    std::vector<uint64_t> q;                   // Q(x), including the x^L term\n    std::vector<uint32_t> base;                // Tempered outputs w_0 .. w_{L-1}\n    std::vector<std::vector<uint64_t>> xpow;   // x^(2^k) mod Q\n};\n\ninline bool gf2Bit(const uint64_t* v, size_t k) { return (v[k >> 6] >> (k & 63)) & 1; }\n\n// dst ^= src << shift\ninline void gf2XorShifted(uint64_t* dst, const uint64_t* src, size_t srcWords, size_t shift) {\n    const size_t ws = shift >> 6;\n    const size_t bs = shift & 63;\n    for (size_t w = 0; w < srcWords; ++w) {\n        const uint64_t v = src[w];\n        if (!v) continue;\n        dst[w + ws] ^= v << bs;\n        if (bs) dst[w + ws + 1] ^= v >> (64 - bs);\n    }\n}\n\n// out = a * b mod Q\nvoid gf2MulMod(const JumpAhead& ja, const uint64_t* a, const uint64_t* b, uint64_t* out) {\n    const size_t W = ja.words;\n    std::vector<uint64_t> prod(2 * W + 1, 0);\n    for (size_t w = 0; w < W; ++w) {\n        uint64_t v = a[w];\n        while (v) {\n            const size_t bit = static_cast<size_t>(__builtin_ctzll(v));\n            v &= v - 1;\n            gf2XorShifted(prod.data(), b, W, w * 64 + bit);\n        }\n    }\n    for (size_t k = 2 * ja.deg - 2; k >= ja.deg; --k) {\n        if (gf2Bit(prod.data(), k)) gf2XorShifted(prod.data(), ja.q.data(), W, k - ja.deg);\n    }\n    std::copy(prod.begin(), prod.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(W), out);\n}\n\n// out = x^e mod Q\nvoid gf2PowX(const JumpAhead& ja, uint64_t e, uint64_t* out) {\n    std::vector<uint64_t> acc(ja.words, 0), tmp(ja.words, 0);\n    acc[0] = 1;\n    for (size_t k = 0; e != 0; ++k, e >>= 1) {\n        if (e & 1) {\n            gf2MulMod(ja, acc.data(), ja.xpow[k].data(), tmp.data());\n            acc.swap(tmp);\n        }\n    }\n    std::copy(acc.begin(), acc.end(), out);\n}\n\n// Engine state (untempered) of the MT19937 stream at position p, where x^p mod Q = X.\n// The engine state is the 624 outputs starting at p, untempered.\nvoid gf2EngineWindow(const JumpAhead& ja, const uint64_t* X, uint32_t* mtOut) {\n    const size_t W = ja.words;\n    std::vector<uint64_t> D(X, X + W);\n    for (int t = 0; t < MT_N; ++t) {\n        uint32_t word = 0;\n        for (size_t w = 0; w < W; ++w) {\n            uint64_t v = D[w];\n            while (v) {\n                const size_t k = w * 64 + static_cast<size_t>(__builtin_ctzll(v));\n                v &= v - 1;\n                word ^= ja.base[k];\n            }\n        }\n        mtOut[t] = mtUntemper(word);\n\n        // D <- x * D mod Q\n        for (size_t w = W - 1; w > 0; --w) D[w] = (D[w] << 1) | (D[w - 1] >> 63);\n        D[0] <<= 1;\n        if (gf2Bit(D.data(), ja.deg)) {\n            for (size_t w = 0; w < W; ++w) D[w] ^= ja.q[w];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Berlekamp-Massey over GF(2). Returns connection polynomial C (C[0] = 1) with\n// s[n] = sum_{k=1..L} C[k] s[n-k] for all n >= L.\nstd::vector<uint8_t> berlekampMassey(const std::vector<uint8_t>& s, size_t& Lout) {\n    const size_t n = s.size();\n    std::vector<uint8_t> C(n + 1, 0), B(n + 1, 0), T;\n    C[0] = 1;\n    B[0] = 1;\n    size_t L = 0;\n    long m = -1;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        uint8_t d = s[i];\n        for (size_t k = 1; k <= L; ++k) d ^= C[k] & s[i - k];\n        if (d) {\n            T = C;\n            const size_t shift = static_cast<size_t>(static_cast<long>(i) - m);\n            for (size_t k = 0; k + shift <= n; ++k) C[k + shift] ^= B[k];\n            if (2 * L <= i) {\n                L = i + 1 - L;\n                m = static_cast<long>(i);\n                B = T;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    C.resize(L + 1);\n    Lout = L;\n    return C;\n}\n\n// Builds the jump-ahead tables. Rank 0 runs Berlekamp-Massey; the result is broadcast.\nJumpAhead buildJumpAhead(uint64_t maxPosition) {\n    JumpAhead ja;\n    constexpr size_t NB = 2 * MT_DEGREE_BOUND + 64;  // Output bits used by Berlekamp-Massey\n\n    uint64_t L = 0;\n    std::vector<uint64_t> qTmp;\n    if (gRank == 0) {\n        std::mt19937 gen(MT_SEED);\n        std::vector<uint8_t> bits(NB);\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < NB; ++k) bits[k] = static_cast<uint8_t>(gen() & 1u);\n\n        size_t degree = 0;\n        const std::vector<uint8_t> C = berlekampMassey(bits, degree);\n        if (2 * degree > NB) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"Jump-ahead: recurrence degree %zu exceeds the bit budget\\n\", degree);\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n        }\n        L = degree;\n        qTmp.assign(L / 64 + 1, 0);\n        // Q(x) = sum_k C[k] x^(L-k)\n        for (size_t k = 0; k <= L; ++k) {\n            if (C[k]) {\n                const size_t bit = L - k;\n                qTmp[bit >> 6] |= 1ull << (bit & 63);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    MPI_Bcast(&L, 1, MPI_UINT64_T, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    ja.deg = static_cast<size_t>(L);\n    ja.words = ja.deg / 64 + 1;\n    if (gRank != 0) qTmp.assign(ja.words, 0);\n    MPI_Bcast(qTmp.data(), static_cast<int>(ja.words), MPI_UINT64_T, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    ja.q = qTmp;\n\n    // Base outputs w_0 .. w_{L-1}\n    std::mt19937 gen(MT_SEED);\n    ja.base.resize(ja.deg);\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < ja.deg; ++k) ja.base[k] = static_cast<uint32_t>(gen());\n\n    // Squarings x^(2^k) mod Q for every exponent bit that can occur\n    size_t bitsNeeded = 1;\n    while ((uint64_t{1} << bitsNeeded) <= maxPosition) ++bitsNeeded;\n    ja.xpow.assign(bitsNeeded, std::vector<uint64_t>(ja.words, 0));\n    ja.xpow[0][0] = 2;  // x\n    for (size_t k = 1; k < bitsNeeded; ++k) gf2MulMod(ja, ja.xpow[k - 1].data(), ja.xpow[k - 1].data(), ja.xpow[k].data());\n    return ja;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Random Number Generation (device side)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Per-thread MT19937 state, as used by one receiver row on the device\nstruct MTState {\n    uint32_t mt[MT_N];\n    uint32_t idx;\n};\n\n__device__ inline uint32_t mtNextRaw(MTState& s) {\n    if (s.idx >= static_cast<uint32_t>(MT_N)) {\n        for (int k = 0; k < MT_N; ++k) {\n            const uint32_t y = (s.mt[k] & 0x80000000u) | (s.mt[(k + 1) % MT_N] & 0x7fffffffu);\n            s.mt[k] = s.mt[(k + MT_M) % MT_N] ^ (y >> 1) ^ ((y & 1u) ? 0x9908b0dfu : 0u);\n        }\n        s.idx = 0;\n    }\n    return mtTemper(s.mt[s.idx++]);\n}\n\n// Same value as std::uniform_real_distribution<float>(0,1) over std::mt19937\n__device__ inline val_t mtUniform(MTState& s) {\n    const val_t u = static_cast<val_t>(mtNextRaw(s)) / 4294967296.0f;\n    return u < ONE ? u : 0.99999994f;  // largest float below 1\n}\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\n__device__ Vec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, MTState& rng) {\n    val_t u = mtUniform(rng);\n    val_t v = mtUniform(rng);\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\n__device__ val_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                                      const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Ray-box slab test of a flattened octree node (separating axis form)\n__device__ bool nodeIntersectsRay(const FlatOctreeNode& node, const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) {\n    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n    Vec3 c = p1 + d - node.center;\n    Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};\n\n    if (fabsf(c.x) > node.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.y) > node.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.z) > node.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > node.halfExtent.y * ad.z + node.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > node.halfExtent.z * ad.x + node.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > node.halfExtent.x * ad.y + node.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nconstexpr int TRAVERSAL_STACK_SIZE = 128;\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle.\n// Traverses the flattened octree, returning true as soon as a blocking triangle is found.\n__device__ bool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                             const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const uint32_t* triIdx, const Triangle* tris,\n                             uint32_t srcTriIdx, uint32_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    uint32_t stack[TRAVERSAL_STACK_SIZE];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;  // root\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--sp]];\n        if (node.triCount > 0) {\n            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < node.triCount; ++k) {\n                const uint32_t idx = triIdx[node.triBegin + k];\n                if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) continue;\n                const Triangle& tri = tris[idx];\n                const val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) return true;\n            }\n        } else {\n            for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) {\n                const int32_t ch = node.child[c];\n                if (ch >= 0 && nodeIntersectsRay(nodes[ch], from, to)) stack[sp++] = ch;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n__device__ val_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    val_t c = v.dot(normal) / vNorm;\n    return c > ZERO ? c : ZERO;\n}\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter).\n// The caller guarantees that the pair is neither the diagonal nor culled.\n__device__ val_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n                            const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const uint32_t* triIdx, const Triangle* tris,\n                            MTState& rng) {\n    const Triangle& triI = tris[idxI];\n    const Triangle& triJ = tris[idxJ];\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, nodes, triIdx, tris, static_cast<uint32_t>(idxI), static_cast<uint32_t>(idxJ))) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI._normal);\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ._normal);\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// One thread per receiver row. The row's draws are the consecutive part of the\n// sequential stream that starts at the row's engine state.\n__global__ void formFactorKernel(size_t i0, size_t rows, size_t N, size_t maskWords,\n                                 const Triangle* tris, const FlatOctreeNode* nodes, const uint32_t* triIdx,\n                                 const uint64_t* skipBits, const uint32_t* rowStates, val_t* kij) {\n    const size_t r = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x;\n    if (r >= rows) return;\n\n    const size_t i = i0 + r;\n    MTState rng;\n    for (int k = 0; k < MT_N; ++k) rng.mt[k] = rowStates[r * MT_N + k];\n    rng.idx = 0;\n\n    const uint64_t* skip = skipBits + r * maskWords;\n    val_t* out = kij + r * N;\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n        const bool skipPair = (skip[j >> 6] >> (j & 63)) & 1u;\n        out[j] = skipPair ? ZERO : computeKij(i, j, nodes, triIdx, tris, rng);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Splits N rows into contiguous blocks; rank r owns [begin, begin + count)\nvoid partitionRows(size_t N, int rank, int size, size_t& begin, size_t& count) {\n    const size_t base = N / static_cast<size_t>(size);\n    const size_t rem = N % static_cast<size_t>(size);\n    const size_t r = static_cast<size_t>(rank);\n    count = base + (r < rem ? 1 : 0);\n    begin = r * base + std::min(r, rem);\n}\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    size_t rowBegin;   // First receiver row owned by this rank\n    size_t rowCount;   // Number of receiver rows owned by this rank\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle (replicated)\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0) (replicated)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors of owned rows (rowCount x N, row-major)\n    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays of owned rows (rowCount x N, row-major)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N, replicated)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N, replicated)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances (N, replicated after gather)\n\n    std::vector<FlatOctreeNode> octNodes;  // Flattened octree for the device\n    std::vector<uint32_t> octTris;\n\n    size_t idxLocal(size_t i, size_t j) const { return (i - rowBegin) * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n    partitionRows(state.numTriangles, gRank, gSize, state.rowBegin, state.rowCount);\n\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration and flatten it for the device\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    Octree octree;\n    octree.build(state.triangles);\n    state.octNodes.clear();\n    state.octTris.clear();\n    flattenOctree(octree, state.octNodes, }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Initialize matrices\n    state.kij.assign(state.rowCount * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.tau.assign(state.rowCount * state.numTriangles, 0);\n    state.radE.assign(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.radB.assign(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.distances.assign(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < state.rowCount; ++r) {\n        const size_t i = state.rowBegin + r;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.tau[r * N + j] = computeTau(state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Pair (i, j) is skipped when i == j or when the facing normals are nearly parallel\n// (culled). skipBits holds one bit per pair (row-major, maskWords words per row),\n// and drawCount[i] is the number of pairs of row i that draw random numbers.\nvoid buildSkipBits(const std::vector<Triangle>& tris, size_t N, size_t maskWords,\n                   std::vector<uint64_t>& skipBits, std::vector<uint64_t>& drawCount) {\n    skipBits.assign(N * maskWords, 0);\n    drawCount.assign(N, 0);\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 16)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        uint64_t* row = skipBits.data() + i * maskWords;\n        const Vec3 ni = tris[i]._normal;\n        uint64_t skipped = 0;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            const bool skip = (i == j) || (ni.dot(tris[j]._normal) > 0.99f);\n            if (skip) {\n                row[j >> 6] |= 1ull << (j & 63);\n                ++skipped;\n            }\n        }\n        drawCount[i] = N - skipped;\n    }\n}\n\n// Computes form factors of the rank's rows on its GPU\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state, const JumpAhead& ja,\n                        const std::vector<uint64_t>& skipBits, size_t maskWords,\n                        const std::vector<uint64_t>& drawPos) {\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t R = state.rowCount;\n    const size_t i0 = state.rowBegin;\n\n    // Engine state at the start of every owned row (jump-ahead, parallel over threads)\n    std::vector<uint32_t> rowStates(R * MT_N, 0);\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        const size_t nthr = static_cast<size_t>(omp_get_num_threads());\n        const size_t tid = static_cast<size_t>(omp_get_thread_num());\n        const size_t b0 = R * tid / nthr;\n        const size_t b1 = R * (tid + 1) / nthr;\n        if (b0 < b1) {\n            std::vector<uint64_t> X(ja.words), next(ja.words), step(ja.words);\n            std::map<uint64_t, std::vector<uint64_t>> stepCache;\n            gf2PowX(ja, drawPos[i0 + b0], X.data());\n            for (size_t r = b0; r < b1; ++r) {\n                gf2EngineWindow(ja, X.data(), &rowStates[r * MT_N]);\n                if (r + 1 < b1) {\n                    const uint64_t draws = drawPos[i0 + r + 1] - drawPos[i0 + r];\n                    auto it = stepCache.find(draws);\n                    if (it == stepCache.end()) {\n                        gf2PowX(ja, draws, step.data());\n                        it = stepCache.emplace(draws, step).first;\n                    }\n                    gf2MulMod(ja, X.data(), it->second.data(), next.data());\n                    X.swap(next);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Device buffers (triangles and octree are replicated; rows are local)\n    Triangle* dTris = nullptr;\n    FlatOctreeNode* dNodes = nullptr;\n    uint32_t* dTriIdx = nullptr;\n    uint64_t* dSkip = nullptr;\n    uint32_t* dStates = nullptr;\n    val_t* dKij = nullptr;\n\n    const size_t kijCount = R * N;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dTris, state.triangles.size() * CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dSkip, std::max<size_t>(R * maskWords, 1) * sizeof(uint64_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dStates, std::max<size_t>(R * MT_N, 1) * sizeof(uint32_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dKij, std::max<size_t>(kijCount, 1) * sizeof(val_t)));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dTris, state.triangles.data(), state.triangles.size() * sizeof(Triangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dNodes, state.octNodes.data(), state.octNodes.size() * sizeof(FlatOctreeNode), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dTriIdx, state.octTris.data(), state.octTris.size() * sizeof(uint32_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    if (R > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dSkip, skipBits.data() + i0 * maskWords, R * maskWords * sizeof(uint64_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dStates, rowStates.data(), R * MT_N * sizeof(uint32_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        constexpr int THREADS = 32;\n        const int blocks = static_cast<int>((R + THREADS - 1) / THREADS);\n        formFactorKernel<<<blocks, THREADS>>>(i0, R, N, maskWords, dTris, dNodes, dTriIdx, dSkip, dStates, dKij);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.kij.data(), dKij, kijCount * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dTris));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dNodes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dTriIdx));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dSkip));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dStates));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dKij));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Per-rank element counts and displacements for a row-block distribution\nvoid rowBlockLayout(size_t N, std::vector<int>& counts, std::vector<int>& displs) {\n    counts.assign(gSize, 0);\n    displs.assign(gSize, 0);\n    for (int r = 0; r < gSize; ++r) {\n        size_t begin = 0, count = 0;\n        partitionRows(N, r, gSize, begin, count);\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(count);\n        displs[r] = static_cast<int>(begin);\n    }\n}\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state, const std::vector<int>& counts, const std::vector<int>& displs) {\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < val_t sumB = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n                if (i == j) continue;\n\n                int tauij = state.tau[r * N + j];\n\n                // Skip if wave hasn't }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ROOT_PRINTF(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < state.rowCount; ++r) {\n        const size_t i = printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = nonZeroKij, totalKij,\n           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(totalKij));\n\n    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation ============================================================================\n// Error Handling and Process Identity\n// while (0)\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                        \\\n    do {                                                                        \\\n        cudaError_t
